verdict.rationale: Parahelp supports release publishing with one-click revert and knowledge version history with diffs (parahelp-docs-4, parahelp-docs-9), directly covering versioning and rollback of configurations/automations. However, there's no explicit review/approval workflow for the versioning itself (approvals exist for actions, not for config changes review), and no evidence of branching, staged review, or audit trail beyond 'who published what and when'. Missing for 10: dedicated review/approval step before publishing a release, granular version comparison across automations (not just knowledge), and independent/hands-on confirmation of rollback working in practice.
